method: Web retrieval of official help, search-index excerpts of the calculator and local source inspection. No interactive reference browser available.

sources.findings: 16 IF97 and 11 IAPWS-95 pairs; 32 outputs; 15 unnamed saturation functions; three turbine and two flash modes; named point/line/spline operations; eight gas percentages totaling 100; Buecker/Span/Wagner 2003, 200–3300 K without dissociation, up to 2000 K with dissociation and complete combustion lambda>1.05; spreadsheet formats.
sources.limitation: Documentation describes intent; inconsistent function counts and old transport limits do not establish current operational behavior.

sources.findings: Eight tabs; default saturation P plus quality, liquid/mixture/vapor columns; 15 turbine result fields including inlet Tsat and exhaust superheat; MW power and lb/(kW h) consumption; transport output units and registration markers.
sources.limitation: Search-index representation; select options, calculations, file contents and authenticated controls were not exercised. Some derivative unit labels appear inconsistent and need live checking.

sources.findings: Turbine consumption default inputs P1,T1,P2,eta,powerMW; flash P1,T1,flow,P2; gas P,T and Ar,CO,CO2,H2O,N2,Ne,O2,SO2, dissociation checkbox, h/s/cp/cv/kappa and component outputs.
sources.limitation: Default indexed form only; conditional fields, percentage basis and dissociation-output definition remain unknown.

sources.findings: Buecker D., Span R., Wagner W.: Thermodynamic Property Models for Moist Air and Combustion Gases, Journal of Engineering for Gas Turbines and Power 125 (2003), 374–384; DOI 10.1115/1.1520154.
sources.limitation: Bibliographic identity confirmed. Full paper, usable coefficient tables, reference conventions and reuse terms not acquired; DOI retrieval unavailable.

sources.findings: R6-95(2018): stable fluid from melting curve to 1273 K and 1000 MPa. Beyond this is extrapolation; lower-temperature liquid can be valid above its melting boundary.
sources.limitation: Scientific validity is separate from the website help claim of 5000 K and 100000 MPa and its untested numerical implementation.

sources.findings: R12-08: melting curve to 1173 K up to 300 MPa, with lower maximum temperatures at higher pressure up to 1000 MPa; scientific critical enhancement differs from industrial use.
sources.limitation: Use the release's complete boundary before any domain expansion; a single rectangular bound is insufficient.

sources.findings: R15-11: melting curve to 1173 K up to 100 MPa, with lower maximum temperatures at higher pressures up to 1000 MPa.
sources.limitation: Do not apply viscosity's larger rectangular domain to conductivity.

sources.findings: Older translated help describes 31 properties while English help and indexed interface describe 32.
sources.limitation: Translation/version conflict. Use identified fields and live results rather than assuming the older total is current.

sources.findings: Seven printed values for 1 MPa, 523.15 K, region 2. P01 preserves all decimal digits and repeats comparison with the current engine and independent IF97.
sources.limitation: Raw network response and exact model metadata are unavailable. Not a new Steam97 query or a full verified scenario.

sources.findings: Current 1.35.4 source and frozen pilot results establish implementation behavior; missing fields and domain caps are recorded separately from reference parity.
sources.limitation: Source inspection and numerical tests do not constitute a browser/UI acceptance.
